name: San Miguel de Allende, Mexico

visa.notes: Temporary resident visa requires ~$1,500/mo income or ~$25,000 savings.

rent.notes: 2BR house/apartment in outer colonias (San Antonio, Ojo de Agua, Los Frailes) 700-1,300 USD and 3BR with garden 1,200-2,000; Guadiana/San Antonio 1-2BR 1,000-1,800; Centro 2BR 1,400-2,400+. Numbeo 3BR outside centre 22,961 MXN (~1,220 USD at 18.8). Pet-friendly house with yard sits mid-range.

utilities.notes: CFE electricity 20-50 USD per bimonthly bill (DAC tariff can exceed 150), LP gas ~20 summer to 60+ winter, municipal water under 15 plus garrafones; Numbeo basic utilities 757 MXN (~40 USD) for 85 m2. A 2-3BR house with winter heating lands near 95. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: IMSS voluntary family insurance for age 60-69 is 19,800 MXN/yr each (2026), ~3,300 MXN/month for two (~176 USD) = minimum. Typical adds a mid-range private/expat plan for one or both (private plans ages 50-65 ~2,000-5,000 USD/yr each; global plans 150-300 USD/month each); full domestic GMM cover for two at 56-65 is 160,000-280,000 MXN/yr (~700-1,250 USD/month). Premiums rose 20-40% in 2026.

transportation.notes: Car-free: green taxis 60-80 MXN per cross-town ride (~3-4.50 USD), local bus 10 MXN; ~30 taxi rides plus shuttles ~110-150 USD. One modest car: gasoline 27.63 MXN/L (~1.47 USD) for ~600 km, plus insurance and maintenance ~160-250.
